title: Geometric Isom stalks for a supplied finite-level model
statement: Let X,Y,g,d,U,n,N,E be as in lem-weil-pbc-lisse-finite-level-etale-descent. Given an etale complex D with bounded cohomology, finite locally constant cohomology, and an isomorphism from lisseTowerFixedRealization of its comparisonUpperStar to the pulled-back N, if the supplied pro-etale covering sieve hmodels exists, then every geometric point of U.left has an inhabited stalk of derivedLocalIsomorphismSheaf from normalizationConstant of E to D.

source.place: Tags 099Y, 099Z and 09B1, bounded-below classical comparison; Tag 09BV, local Isom torsors.

proof.text: Construct an etale local representative of the derived Isom presheaf at every geometric point from the comparison and covering model data.
Pass the pointed etale local representative through the sheafification unit and point-fibre colimit to obtain an inhabited geometric stalk.

proof_origin.place: Tags 099Y, 099Z, 09B1 and 09BV, split into local representative construction and stalk evaluation.

lean.statement:
theorem lisse_finite_level_etale_stalks
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (U : Y.ProEt) (n : ℕ)
    (N : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))))
    (E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)))
    (D : DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf U.left.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n))))
    (hDbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj D))
    (hDlisse : ∀ q : ℤ, IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj D))
    (hcomparison : Nonempty ((lisseTowerFixedRealization (U.hom ≫ g) d n).obj
        ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)) U.left).mapDerivedCategory.obj D) ≅
        (adicTowerPullback (U.hom ≫ g) ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj N))
    (hmodels : ∃ T : Sieve U, T ∈ ProEt.topology Y U ∧
      ∀ (W : Y.ProEt) (w : W ⟶ U), T w →
        Nonempty ((constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d n).obj E ≅
          (adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g)
            ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj N)) :
    ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U.left),
      Nonempty ((pointSmallEtale x).sheafFiber.obj (derivedLocalIsomorphismSheaf
        ((normalizationConstant U.left.smallEtaleTopology).obj E) D))
